notes.title: 1.2.6 Release notes
notes.content:
FEATURES
[list]
[*] Reworked block mechanics: when block is used, it stays up as a barrier until the enemy's next physical attack. It blocks damage once and then disappears. No need to time it to animation anymore!
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Added marker indicating new map available
[/list]

FIXES
[list]
[*] Fixed being able to sell consumable items after they were autoconsumed, if sales window was open during this time
[*] Fixed discrepancy between calculated attack time on higher levels and actual speed
[/list]

tags.feature: Reworked block mechanics: when block is used, it stays up as a barrier until the enemy's next physical attack. It blocks damage once and then disappears. No need to time it to animation anymore!
Added marker indicating new map available

notes.title: 1.1.8 Release notes
notes.content:
[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now right click to learn new skills
[*] When game window is minimised, you will now get a flash notification on taskbar if you’re out of arrows
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Added drop enhancement for undiscovered loot
[*] grass hopper shield 6 ➝ 11 armour
[*] spike shield 14 ➝ 17 armour
[*] Elder shield 15 defence 25 block ➝ 15 defence 23 block
[*] Plate shield 15 defence 25 block ➝ 16 defence 25 block
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved readability of Fairy panel
[*] Added item info in the world map
[*] Added marker indicating skill tree reset available
[*] You can view description of the each statistic now by hovering mouse over without clicking at stat icon
[/list]

[b]ANIMATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Thunder Bolt animation to young Hero sprite
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Ammunition counter now shows correctly in front of [spoiler]Frost Terror[/spoiler] arm.
[*] Coins shadows display correctly instead of nyooming over them
[*] Fixed sorting issues with slingshots and consumables with the same price
[/list]

[b]OTHER[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked visuals in tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.0 Release notes
notes.content:
BALANCE
[list]
[*] Small MP regen skill node change 0.05 ➝ 0.08
[*] Seal MP regen skill node change 100% ➝ 20%
[*] Master Bloodline crit chance 1 ➝ 4
[*] Always ready perk 1 ➝ 2 defence
[*] Initial xp for skills reduced from 30 to 24
[*] Add 5 time thresholds to rewards 
[*] Proficiency connector mechanic changed to: “Telekinetic Proficiency” - Learn one out of reach skill for free
[/list]

ENEMIES
[list]
[*] Reduced movement speed of most ranged enemies
[*] Mountain troll, pixies complex balance
[*] XP for defeating Guard’s Captain without finishing the quest lowered
[/list]

ITEMS
[list]
[*] Massive daggers crit chance buff
[*] Axes power and def reduced
[*] Slightly buffed shields def and block and maces power
[*] Added Lucky Shield and Glowing Shield
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Perk tree nodes won’t blink now if there are no free points available
[*] Made some adjustments to Perk Tree connectors visibility
[*] Added animations for big and small nodes while learning perks 
[*] Reworked Telekinetic Proficiency (Proficiency Connector) buy animation
[/list]

FIXES
[list]
[*] Fixed Health Ectoplasm not taking away mana
[*] Made entrance to [spoiler]Secret Laboratory[/spoiler] more visible after defeating the Prince
[*] Additional perk point obtained after the Size Brothers quest will no longer be available if you reset your run
[*] Added unsupported local save detection to avoid corrupting save while switching from newer to older version of the game
[*] Fixed ammunition sprites changing incorrectly
[*] Fixed Inventor quest dialogue playing during fight with him
[*] Fix blinking sewage pipe  in Far Sewers while critical hit or block buttons were active
[/list]

SOUND
[list]
[*] Added level up sound
[*] Fixed issues with music while changing output devices
[/list]

OTHER
[list]
[*] New visuals for Gate Guard
[*] New background animations in Cave and Cave Entrance
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.8 Release notes
notes.content:
BALANCE
[list]
[*] Reduced quantity of final reward arrows
[*] stone arrow: down to 30 per reward
[*] cool bolt: down to 30 per reward
[*] ice arrow: down to 70 per reward
[*] Reduced amount of enemies needed to unlock next tile from 10  to  8
[*] Reduced rebel quest amount from 30 to 12
[*] Counter Attack Perk buffed from 5 seconds to 8 seconds
[*] Greedy Alchemy Perk changed: no more MP regeneration, added 20 MP when picked
[*] Arcanic Taboo Perk changed: no more additional MP when picked, added reduces number of enemies to defeat to unlock the next tile
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Switched block quick button from “B” to “X”
[*] Accelerated mouse wheel zooming in and out in skill tree
[/list]

OTHER
[list]
[*] T2 & T3 training with Guards Captain buffed
[*] Added some background animations
[*] FIXES
[*] Fixed end screen runtime display after winning Boss fight
[*] Fixed issue with runtime stopping to count up after certain amount of hours
[*] Fixed items locked in sale mode in the inventory, after quitting the shop by hitting “Esc”, not in-game button
[*] Fixed “Passionate Ornithologist” achievement triggering even if you already left the Town and came back to Harpy Nest after that
[*] Fixed “space” icon changing to system language instead of using chosen language in game.
[*] Fixed dialogues repeating the first line indefinitely after using space to skip and progressing only after clicking the mouse button.
[*] Fixed space button activating heal spell in some circumstances
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Reduced quantity of final reward arrows
- stone arrow: down to 30 per reward
- cool bolt: down to 30 per reward
- ice arrow: down to 70 per reward
- Reduced amount of enemies needed to unlock next tile from 10  to  8
- Reduced rebel quest amount from 30 to 12
- Counter Attack Perk buffed from 5 seconds to 8 seconds
- Greedy Alchemy Perk changed: no more MP regeneration, added 20 MP when picked
- Arcanic Taboo Perk changed: no more additional MP when picked, added reduces number of enemies to defeat to unlock the next tile

- Accelerated mouse wheel zooming in and out in skill tree
